verdict.rationale: ReadMe ships its own AI features that analyze your documentation content and suggest changes. The AI Linter and Docs Audit check every page against natural-language rules to find outdated content, broken links and style issues, and the GitHub AI Writer proposes doc updates when pull requests change your code. Its analytics (API Metrics, MCP Metrics) are documented only as reports, not as AI-generated insights. Missing for 10: AI-generated insights from usage and analytics data, a documented in-product AI insights or suggestions surface beyond content linting, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Docs Audit runs your Linter rules against every page in your project in a single pass, so you can find outdated content, broken links, and style inconsistencies across your entire site
An AI-powered tool for checking page content against your own style guide.
The GitHub AI Writer keeps your documentation in sync with your codebase by watching your pull requests and proposing updates when code changes affect your docs.
